legend.numbers: Skills in on-screen order. 6 = Ultimate, Awakened or Tier-4.
legend.c: Cancel: cancel the animation right after using it, firing the next skill.
legend.dc: Delayed Cancel: wait a split second (the hit effect or the end of the animation) before cancelling into the next one.
legend.qc: Quick Cancel: cancel immediately after the input.
legend.optional: Optional part or combo "filler" before the main bonus.
legend.start: Rotation start (shown automatically at the beginning of each rotation).
legend.restart: Goes back to the start and repeats the rotation.

errors.token: Couldn't read “{{token}}”: use 1–6 (with c, dc or qc), parentheses, |, / or *.
errors.unopenedGroup: There is a “)” without a “(” before it.
errors.nestedGroup: You can't open a parenthesis inside another.

states.slow: This is taking longer than usual: the server may be waking up. Just a few more seconds.

security.label: Account security notices
security.notMe: Wasn't you? Ask an administrator to change your password.

toast.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session expired. Sign in again to keep syncing.
toast.SELECTIONS_SYNCED: Roster and teams synced with your account.

NEW_LOGIN.title: New sign-in to your account
NEW_LOGIN.text: Your account was accessed from another device or browser on {{date}}.

FAILED_LOGINS.title: Sign-in attempts with a wrong password
FAILED_LOGINS.text: There were several attempts to sign in to your account with a wrong password on {{date}}.

PASSWORD_RESET.title: Password reset
PASSWORD_RESET.text: Your account password was reset on {{date}}.

ROLE_CHANGED.title: Account role changed
ROLE_CHANGED.text: Your account now has the {{role}} role (changed on {{date}}).

ACCOUNT_LOCKED.title: Account temporarily locked
ACCOUNT_LOCKED.text: Sign-in was locked for a few minutes on {{date}} after too many wrong password attempts.

nickname.label: Your in-game name
nickname.hint: Stays on this device only, with your roster and teams. No account needed.

resetTeams.title: Clear my teams
resetTeams.text: Deletes the teams you built: all at once or one mode only. Your roster, equipped CTPs and name are kept.
resetTeams.confirmAll: Delete all your BAX, BAL and BAI teams?

sync.title: Choose which selections to keep
sync.text: This device and your account have different rosters/teams. Which version do you want to keep? The other will be replaced.

NETWORK.title: Can't reach the server
NETWORK.text: Check your internet. What you marked on this device is not lost; try again when you're back online.

DATABASE.title: Can't reach the database
DATABASE.text: The server couldn't access the data right now. Try again in a moment; if it keeps happening, tell an administrator.

SERVER.title: Server error
SERVER.text: Something went wrong on our side. Try again; if it keeps happening, tell an administrator.

FORBIDDEN.title: Access denied
FORBIDDEN.text: Your account isn't allowed to do this. If you think it's a mistake, talk to an administrator.

SESSION_EXPIRED.title: Your session ended
SESSION_EXPIRED.text: For your security, sign in again to continue.

RATE_LIMITED.title: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a few minutes.

CONFLICT.title: The data changed somewhere else at the same time.
